scp2845.scp_unleashed.lead.falling: A pale light is falling from the sky
jade.scp_unleashed.scp2845.title: SCP-2845 The Deer
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp2845_spawn_egg: SCP-2845 The Deer: a tall green deer with a pale, sleeping face, vast dark antlers and a broken ring of floating stones behind its head. Keter-class.
It attacks people and animals alike. It can shake the ground, make the air burst, lift its victims off their feet and turn them to stone.
Weapons do not harm it. Nothing that has been tried has harmed it.
It never spawns naturally. Its file comes from the Archive.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp2845_stone.1: SCP-2845-2: an egg-shaped stone of pale veined rock, faintly marked with glyphs. It arrives with SCP-2845-1.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp2845_stone.2: While the deer roams free, nothing will chip it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp2845_pillar.1: What remains of those SCP-2845-1 turns to stone. It can be mined like any other rock, if you can bear to.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp2845.1: It was never caught. Only persuaded.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.title: The Deer
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.caption: SCP-2845-1 photographed from the crater rim during the first response. SCP-2845-2 is visible at its feet.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.page.0.text.0: SCP-2845 cannot be contained by force. All attempts to restrain, wound or trap SCP-2845-1 have failed, and personnel are not to attempt them again.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.page.0.text.1: SCP-2845-2 is to be guarded where it lies. When SCP-2845-1 is held, it is held under Procedure 2845-Accord. %rThe procedure is restricted to Level 4 personnel.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.page.0.text.2: **The procedure must be renewed at regular intervals.** If it lapses, all staff are to leave the area at once and are not to stand between SCP-2845-1 and the open air.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.page.1.text.0: SCP-2845-1 is a deer twice the height of a man, with grey-green fur and a pale, hairless face like a sleeping person's. Its eyes have never been seen to open.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.page.1.text.1: Faint points of light move inside its vast dark antlers. A broken ring of pale stones and glass beads turns slowly behind its head without touching it.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.page.1.text.2: SCP-2845-2 is an egg-shaped stone of pale veined rock, marked with faint glyphs in no known script. It cannot be chipped, cut or moved while SCP-2845-1 roams free.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.page.1.text.3: SCP-2845-1 is hostile to all living things. It has been seen to make the air burst, to lift people from the ground, to call running shapes of deer out of nothing, and to turn people and animals into columns of stone.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.page.2.title: Addendum 2845-A: Recovery
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.page.2.text: SCP-2845 arrived as a pale falling light that struck the ground near a reader of this file. No impactor was found. SCP-2845-1 was standing in the crater, and SCP-2845-2 lay beside it.
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.page.3.title: Addendum 2845-B: The Woodcut
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.page.3.text: A woodcut of unknown age was found in a regional archive. It shows a stag with closed eyes, its head lowered over an oval stone. The stone sits at the centre of a square drawn in white. Only one line of the caption can still be read: %r"It cannot be held. It can only be asked."%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.page.4.title: Addendum 2845-C: Incident Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.2845.page.4.text: After many quiet days, SCP-2845-1 called once and walked out of the site in a straight line. Nothing in its path was left standing. %rThe renewal had been missed by a single day.%r
